tools.name: answer_from_blog
tools.description: Answers a question using relevant evidence from Pawel's blog posts.

question.description: The question to answer from blog content.

tools.name: find_blog_posts
tools.description: Finds blog posts by topic, title, tags, or content. Use intent recommend for learning goals.

query.description: Topic, keyword, or learning goal, for example Angular performance or WebMCP.

intent.description: search for exact matches; recommend for learning goals with a recent-post fallback.

tools.name: find_relevant_experience
tools.description: Finds resume experience relevant to a user's project, need, or technology.

query.description: The user's project need or technology, for example Angular audit or SSR.

tools.name: get_author_perspective
tools.description: Finds Pawel's perspective on a topic based on his blog posts.

topic.description: The topic to infer Pawel's perspective on.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Lists navigable site pages and recent blog posts with paths.

section.description: Which section to list. Defaults to all.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigates to a site page or blog post by path.

path.description: A site path such as /blog, /about, or /blog/post-slug.

tools.name: summarize_blog_post
tools.description: Summarizes a blog post by slug using Chrome Summarizer API when available, with a safe fallback.

slug.description: Optional blog post slug. If omitted, the currently opened blog post is summarized.
